title: The AI Productivity Index (APEX)
authors_zh: Bertie Vidgen, Abby Fennelly, Evan Pinnix, Julien Benchek, Daniyal Khan 等
paper_type_zh: 专业知识工作的人类专家 rubric 评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究专业任务评测、LLM Judge 与经济价值导向能力测量的读者。
one_line: APEX assesses professional finance, law, consulting, and medical work using expert-authored cases and rubric grading.
APEX 以资深从业者设计的任务、材料和 rubric，检验模型能否完成金融、法律、咨询和医疗中的高价值专业工作。
why: It tests whether model outputs meet client-ready standards in high-value professional tasks.
inclusion_reason: APEX evaluates economically valuable professional work with expert-authored task rubrics.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Common LLM benchmarks emphasise exams, short QA, or coding and poorly represent economically valuable work in investment banking, consulting, law, and primary care, where long-form deliverables, file handling, and professional judgment matter. Without economically grounded tasks, model progress cannot be connected clearly to real productivity.

APEX has experienced practitioners author tasks and itemised criteria from their daily work, then evaluates deliverable quality with an LM judge and expert references while comparing cost, speed, and human performance.

常用大模型基准多测考试知识、短问答或代码，难以反映投资银行、咨询、法律和基层医疗中需要长文交付、文件处理与专业判断的高价值工作。缺少经济相关任务会使模型能力增长与实际生产率之间无法建立可解释联系。

APEX 让资深从业者依据日常工作编写任务和逐项标准，用 LM Judge 与专家参考共同评价交付质量，并比较模型成本、速度和人工专家表现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: APEX-v1.0 evaluates 200 cases across investment banking, management consulting, big law, and primary care, with expert-authored prompts, reference deliverables, and rubrics. The public APEX-v1-extended release provides 25 downloadable tasks per occupation, 100 in total, for professional-response evaluation and judge calibration. The full paper benchmark and the public subset must be distinguished rather than treating 100 as the total scale.
APEX-v1.0 完整评测含 200 个案例，覆盖投行、管理咨询、大型律所和基层医疗四类职业；专家为任务编写提示、参考产物和 rubric。公开 APEX-v1-extended 提供每个职业 25 个、共 100 个可下载任务，适合专业回答评测和 Judge 校准。必须区分论文完整基准与公开示例子集，不能把 100 条误写为全文总规模。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Recruit experts: Bankers, consultants, lawyers, and physicians with top-tier experience define representative high-value work.
  1. Author tasks: Experts create prompts, input files, deliverable requirements, and references from real workflows rather than knowledge recall.
  1. Design rubrics: Client readiness, factuality, analysis, format, and professional standards are decomposed into assessable criteria.
  1. Evaluate models: Models produce deliverables scored by an LM judge and compared with experts; public subset, judge, files, and reasoning settings must be fixed.

1. 招募专家： 选择具有顶级机构经历的银行家、顾问、律师和医生，定义代表性高价值工作。
  1. 编写任务： 专家依据真实日常流程制作提示、输入文件、交付要求和参考答案，避免仅测试知识回忆。
  1. 设计 rubric： 将客户可用性、事实、分析、格式和专业规范拆成可逐项判定的标准。
  1. 评测模型： 模型生成成果后由 LM Judge 评分并与专家比较；复现需固定公开子集、Judge、文件和推理设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 23 frontier models on APEX-v1.0, GPT-5 with high reasoning scores 64.2%, followed by Grok 4 at 61.3% and Gemini 2.5 Flash with thinking at 60.4%; Qwen3-235B is the best open model and ranks seventh. The results show a remaining gap from experts and sensitivity to reasoning settings, but benchmark scores should not be equated directly with job-replacement rates.
APEX-v1.0 对 23 个前沿模型的评测中，GPT-5 高思考设置平均得分 64.2%，Grok 4 为 61.3%，Gemini 2.5 Flash 思考模式为 60.4%，最佳开源模型 Qwen3-235B 排名第七。结果显示前沿模型与专家仍有明显差距，也表明推理设置会改变专业任务表现；但这些分数不能直接等价为真实岗位替代率。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier occupational benchmarks often reduce work to QA or one file, with rubrics written by researchers rather than practitioners. APEX derives real deliverable tasks from four economically valuable occupations and has experienced experts define both tasks and acceptance standards, combining quality, cost, and speed. It measures professional artefacts rather than generic knowledge.
既有职业基准常把专业工作压缩为问答或单个文件，且 rubric 由研究者而非从业者设定。APEX 的变化是从四类高 GDP 价值职业抽取真实交付任务，由资深专家同时定义任务和验收标准，并将质量、成本与速度放在同一评测框架。它测量的是专业产物，而非一般知识。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: The full 200-task benchmark is not completely released; external users mainly access the 100-task public subset.
  1. Limitation 2: Four occupations and U.S.-centred practice do not represent all economies, countries, or seniority levels.
  1. Limitation 3: The LM judge may favour particular styles, and client readiness still requires practitioner review.

1. 局限1： 完整 200 题并未全部开放，外部研究者主要能使用 100 题公开子集。
  1. 局限2： 四类职业和美国机构实践不能代表全部经济活动、国家和资历层级。
  1. 局限3： LM Judge 可能偏好特定写作风格，客户可用性仍需从业者整体复核。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare model deliverable quality across four professions and report each occupation separately.
  1. Use case 2: Use public tasks and rubrics to calibrate professional judges against expert ratings.
  1. Use case 3: For job automation claims, additionally measure workflows, liability, review cost, and long-term errors.

1. 使用场景1： 比较通用模型在四类专业工作中的交付质量，并按职业分别报告。
  1. 使用场景2： 用公开任务和 rubric 校准专业 Judge，测与专家评分的一致性。
  1. 使用场景3： 评估岗位自动化时还应测真实工作流、责任、复核成本和长期错误。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Measure economically valuable professional deliverables through practitioner-authored tasks.
  2. Method: Expert recruitment, real tasks, reference artefacts, rubrics, and an LM judge.
  3. Data: The paper has 200 cases; the public extended subset has 100.
  4. Evidence: GPT-5 high reasoning leads at 64.2% but remains below experts.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for professional judges; do not interpret scores directly as job replacement.

1. 一句话定位： 用资深从业者任务衡量经济价值较高的专业交付。
  2. 方法抓手： 专家招募、真实任务、参考产物、rubric 和 LM Judge。
  3. 数据抓手： 论文 200 题；公开 extended 子集为 100 题。
  4. 证据锚点： 最佳 GPT-5 高思考为 64.2%，与专家仍有差距。
  5. 复用决定： 适合专业 Judge；不能把分数直接解释为岗位替代。
